Zoe: Postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-142 — consolidating owners for alert tuning: noise pruning, threshold retunes, dedupe/suppression, and paging routing. Drop your commits here.
FollowupBot: Incident INC-2026-142 archived at 2026-05-20T02:12:00Z. Postmortem: /incidents/INC-2026-142.
Malik: I'll own suppression/dedupe. Plan: 21-day dry-run + false-suppression matrix. ETA: Wed EOD. Will post CSV results.
Jun: I'll take thresholds and the 24h canary dashboard. Need p95/p99 for inference.* and api.* metrics. Will share SQL + charts tomorrow AM.
Priya: Paging/rota on me. Proposal: create `overnight-low-touch` 23:30-06:30 and coalesce identical alerts for 10m. Exclude CI/test namespaces from paging.
Zoe: Good. Tag PRs with label `pm-followup/INC-2026-142` and include runbook snippets for support. Target: PRs up by 2026-05-26.
Malik: Draft suppression rule (dry-run):
```
# suppress repeated grpc timeouts by instance
if count(error: "grpc_timeout", instance) > 12/min then suppress 30m
```
I'll run dry-run and post impact. Aiming for <2% false-suppression.
Jun: Threshold plan:
- collect rolling 30d p95/p99 and spike ratios
- propose moving noisy alerts to new thresholds where p99 > 1.8x baseline or spike > 3x
I'll attach graphs and change list by 09:30 PT.
Priya: For paging I'll add a regex filter `^ci-|^test-` and create a canary route first. Also adding a checklist item to include a short rollback procedure.
Zoe: Owners summary: suppression = Malik, thresholds = Jun, paging = Priya, PM = Zoe. Sequence:
1) Jun: recurrence/threshold analysis + canary metrics (tomorrow 09:30 PT)
2) Malik: dedupe dry-run + PR (Wed EOD)
3) Priya: paging config + canary (Fri)
4) Zoe: consolidate rollout doc + schedule 20m post-rollout check (by next Mon)
Jun: Also proposing a recurrence detector prototype: flags alerts with >6 occurrences in 30d and pattern_score >0.6. If flagged, route to engineering backlog instead of suppression. Will post prototype output.
Malik: If recurrence flag exists, I'll filter suppression candidates to avoid hiding recurring systemic issues.
Priya: Adding rollback automation idea: if total alert volume increases >12% in 24h after changes, auto-revert routing/thresholds. I'll add the metric to the canary dashboard.
Zoe: Please react with :white_check_mark: when PRs are up so I can mark the tracker. If you hit blockers (data perms, infra), call it out here and we'll reassign.
Jun: :white_check_mark: I'll post SQL + charts tomorrow.
Malik: :white_check_mark: draft branch `suppress-142` created, will attach dry-run logs.
Priya: :white_check_mark: canary route branch pushed, will open PR by Fri.
